We understand capacity issues because we work in the arts and Museum Detox is volunteer-run.

So we won’t invalidate where you’re coming from. 

But we’re not centring white people’s emotions and those in your marketing team either. 

It’s #BlackLivesMatter

Capacity says one thing but not everything.

It is super telling that some folks did not stutter and could tweet out in solidarity #BlackLivesMatter and those who couldn’t. 

What’s blocking your values matching up to your actions?

What does that say about your organisation?

It’s been a busy week this week, I’m in and out atm. 

I just wanted to say that these are the faces in the Museum Detox Exec Team. 

Hold us accountable with #BlackLivesMatter - we are no exception. 

We’ll endeavour to do learn, unlearn, and do better. We’re listening. https://t.co/Trs4Hoi0wb
